senses.gloss: increase, plenty. Esth. R. end מדות … בשפע בפירוי ובר׳ the good dispensations of the Lord come with liberality, fruitfulness, and plenty.
(sub. בגדים) larger number of garments, investment of the high priest with the eight official garments.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 5a:12">Yoma 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 29:29">Ex. XXIX, 29</cite> sq.) <he>איתקש משיחה לר׳ מה ר׳ וכ׳</he> the anointing is put on a level with the investment, as the investment is continued for seven days, so is the anointing &c.
<cite ref="Exodus 29:29">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ שבעה … איכא בינייהו</he> they differ as to the seven days of investment and the seven days of anointment; a. e.

senses.gloss: extension of scope, widening qualification, amplification, opp. מִיעוּט.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 3:5">Shebu. III, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shevuot 25a:20">25ᵃ</cite>) <he>מר׳ הכתוב</he> I derive it from the amplification of the text (the addition of a general rule <he>לכל אשר וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 5:4">Lev. V, 4</cite>); ib. 26ᵃ.

<cite ref="Menachot 89a:3">Men. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ר׳ אחר ר׳ אלא למעט</he> an amplification following an amplification (as <he>בשמן</he> in <cite ref="Leviticus 2:4">Lev. II, 4</cite>) intimates a restriction; a. fr.—Pl. <he>רִיבּוּיִין</he>, <cite ref="T00586"><he>רִבּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:4">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>, a. e. <he>אתין וגמין ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00993"><he>גַּם</he> I</cite>.
